book.name: LUCAS
book.title: JA' WATX' K'ANE TZ'IBEBIL CAN YU NAJ LUCAS

content: Ja' Naj Lucas Jix Tz'ibentoj Jun Juun Ti' Tet Naj Teófilo

Ja' tinani' xin, chin tz'ibetoj jun juun ti' e ach Teófilo, yet watx' cha wotajne el oj, tol yel wan tzet yetal jix ja cuy el tu'. Cax c'al ec'al ánima jix tz'ibentoj wan tzet yetal jix yun cu xol ti', pero jix jin na' tol watx' ta chi waltoj e ach masanil tzet jix yun yin xolilal yet tax jix ẍa'on el yich. Ja' eb chi alon el sk'ane Dios tinani', ec'al eb jix ilon wan tu' yet tax jix ẍa'on el yich. Ja' yin jix cu cuyle yu eb on. Jix jin cuy masanil wan ti' yin c'uan c'ulal yet watx' chi ske' jin tz'ibentoj e ach yin jichan.
Albil Can Yu Jun Ángel Tol Oj Aloj Naj Juan Bautista

Ja' yet ey oc Herodes yaawil bey tx'otx' Judea, ey jun bulan eb yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios chi yij sbi Abías. Ey jun winaj xol eb chi yij sbi Zacarías. Elisabet sbi yistil naj. Yic'aal to Aarón pax ix.
Watx' sbeybal eb scawanil yul sat Dios. Jijyom eb tet ẍejbanil c'al tet sley naj Kaawil. Yuxan c'am junoj mac chi ske' yaloni, tol ey junoj spenail eb.
C'am junoj yuninal eb, yutol man unewom oj ix. Yetoj pax oj icham ánima xa eb scawanil.
Ja' yet jun c'ual, yet jix a apnoj stiempoal yak'wi servil Zacarías yetoj jaywan xa eb yetbi, yet chi ak'le servil Dios yu eb Israel,

jix yaoc puesto eb, jaxca c'al ta' sbeybal eb jun jun ta' el, yu xeclo el mac oj cha'on jun opiso tu'. Ja' yiban Zacarías jix eyi. Yuxan jix octoj naj yul stemplo naj Kaawil. Jix bet yak'on tz'a' pom suk'uk'i sab.
Ja' yet jix yak'on tz'a' tu', masanil eb ánima ey oc titu' ey can eb sti' templo txaloj.
Ja' yet ey octoj tu', jix jul x'oxon ec' sba jun yángel naj Kaawil tet Zacarías tu'. Jix jul ec' wojan bey jun pac' smeẍail snusbanil pom tu' bey yet c'ulal swatx' k'ab Zacarías.
Ja' yet jix yilon yin jun ángel naj tu', caw jix q'uey a sc'ul. Jix xiw can a naj yu.
Catu' jix yalon jun ángel tu' tet naj jaxca ti': —Zacarías, manchej jaach xiwi, jix yab Dios ja txa. Yuxan, ja' ja wetbi Elisabet, oj aloj jun swinaj unin. Juan oj ja wak' yij sbi naj.
Caw oj tzala je c'ul yin. Ec'al ánima oj tzala a yet oj yabeni tol jix ali jun je yuninal.
Ja' jun unin tu', caw miman oj yun yel oc apnoj yul sat Dios. Man oj yuc' vino, man oj yuc' an. Ey xa oc Santo Espíritu yin naj yet oj aloj naj.
Ec'al eb Israel oj swa'ne oc sba yin naj Kaawil Dios junel xa yu jun ja c'aal tu'.

Ja' naj Juan tu' oj baboj sattaj naj Kaawil. Jaxca c'al sna'bal naj Elías c'al yipal naj, quey tu' oj yun sna'bal c'al yipal naj ja c'aal. Yuxan oj tenchanele eb mame, c'al eb uninale yet ey jowal xol eb, yet watx' chi tan el oj. Ja' oj q'uexon pax sna'bal eb, yet watx' ey eb listo xa ye yet oj jul naj Kaawil, ẍi jun ángel tu'.
Jix yalon Zacarías tu' tet jun ángel jaxca ti': —¿Tzet oj yun wotajne el oj ta tol yel wan cha wal ti'? Yutol jainti', caw icham jin xa an, yetoj wetbi an, ixnam xa pax ix, ẍi naj tet jun ángel.
Jix yalon jun ángel tu' tet naj: —Jain, Gabriel jin an. Yak'omal jin servil Dios an. Jain jix jin chejletej yu jul walon jun k'ane ti' e ach an.

Tinani', ma xa ske' ja k'anab nioj, masanta' c'al oj aloj jun unin jix wal tu' an. Yutol ma ja waoc yin ja c'ul tzet jix wal tu' an, yuxan quey tu' oj ja wune. Ja' to yet oj apnoj stiempoal catu' oj yunen jun ti', ẍi jun ángel tu' tet naj.
Ja' eb ánima chi yechbane yeltej Zacarías tu'. Jix q'uey a sc'ul eb yutol caw miman tiempo jix bet octoj naj yul stemplo Dios tu'.
Jaxa yet jix eltej, ma xa ske' sk'anab tet eb. Jix sna'on el eb conob tu' tol ey junoj tzet yetal jix x'ox Dios tet naj. Sk'ab xa c'al jix x'ox yin yechel oj, yutol jix maji el sti' naj.
Jix apnoj stiempoal jix lwai yak'le servil yu naj Zacarías, catu' jix paxtoj eb bey sna.
Man to pey oj tu', catu' jix yijon oc unin ix Elisabet. Joeb xaaw ey xa c'al ec' ix bey sna. Jix c'oli sna'ontanen jaxca ti':
“Yu yipal naj Kaawil, yuxan quey tu' chi wun an, yetoj pax yet watx' c'am xa chi al-le jin k'umal yu ánima, yutol c'am wune' an,” ẍi ix.
Jix Al-le Tet Ix María Yu Jun Ángel Tol Oj Aloj Naj Jesús
Wajeb xa xaaw yijon oc jun unin ix Elisabet tu', catu' jix chejletej ángel Gabriel yu Dios bey conob Nazaret, bey tx'otx' Galilea.
Jix jul ec' bey jun ix k'opo chi yij sbi María. C'am to chi yil-le sba yetoj junoj winaj. Ja' jun ix tu', ey xa strato ix yetoj jun winaj chi yij sbi José, ic'aale to ye naj yu naj rey David.

Jix octoj jun ángel tu' bey ey ec' ix. Jix yalon tet ix jaxca ti': —Tzalaan c'al yutol caw xaan jaach yu naj Kaawil Dios. Ey oc Dios ja wetoj. Yel xa c'al miman swatx' c'ulal Dios jix yak' e ach sattaj masanil ja wet ixal, ẍi ángel Gabriel.
Ja' yet jix yilon oc ix yin jun ángel tu', jix q'uey a sc'ul ix. Jix sna'ontej ix tzet chi yal yel oc apnoj tzet jix yal jun ángel tu'.
Catu' jix yalon pax jun ángel tu' tet ix jaxca ti': —María, manchej jaach xiwi, yutol miman swatx' c'ulal Dios jix x'ox e ach.
Ja' tinani', oj oc jun unin ja win, oj aloj jun winaj unin ja wu. Jesús, oj ja wak' yij sbi.

Caw miman winaj oj yun yel oc oj. Oj bina oj tol sc'aal jun yel xa c'al miman yel oc apnoj, ja' ton Dios. Ja' Dios Kaawil tu', oj aon oc naj reyal. Catu' oj oc can sq'uexel oj naj rey David, naj yichmam naj.
Oj oc Yaawil oj eb ja wet conob Israel yin tobal k'inal. C'am bak'in oj lawoj jun yopiso tu', ẍi jun ángel tu' tet ix.
—¿Pero tzet oj yun ske'on jun cha wal tu'? Jainti' c'am to wetbi, ẍi ix tet jun ángel tu'.
—Ja' Santo Espíritu oj jul ja wiban. Ja' yipal naj yel xa c'al miman yel oc apnoj tu', ja' oj eyol yenel ja wiban. Yuxan, ja' jun unin oj aloj tu' yet c'al Dios yei. Oj bina oj, tol Sc'aal Dios naj.
Catu' ja' ja wican Elisabet, caw ixnam xa ix, pero oj aloj jun swinaj unin. Chi yal eb ánima tol c'am bak'in oj yil junoj unin ix. Pero wajeb xa xaaw yijon oc unin ix tinani'.
Yutol masanil chi c'al ske' yu Dios, ẍi jun ángel tu' tet ix.
Catu' jix tak'wi ix María: —Ẍejab Kaawil wei, yuxan ske' ojab jaxca jix ja wal tu', ẍi ix tet jun ángel tu': Jix lawi tu' xin, catu' jix to jun ángel tu'.
Yet Jix Bet Il-le Ix Elisabet Yu Ix María
Txenxane tiempo catu' jix to María bey jun conob ey ey xol wan wonquiltaj tx'otx' yul yet Judea.
Jix apni ix bey sna naj Zacarías. Jix ak'le scawil sc'ul ix Elisabet yu ix.
Ja' yet jix yaben Elisabet sk'anab ix María tu', catu' jix bilwi a jun unin ey xa oc yin ix tu'. Catu' caw ey oc Santo Espíritu yin ix Elisabet tu'.
Catu' jix yalon ix yin ipal jaxca ti': —Jaachti', yel miman swatx' c'ulal Dios jix x'ox e ach sattaj masanil eb ix ket ixal. Miman pax swatx' c'ulal oj x'ox tet jun oj aloj ja wu.
Jainti', c'am nioj wel oc apnoj, jal jaachti' xin, xutx jaach naj Kaawil. Pero chach jul pax k'anab wetoj an.
Asanne c'al jix waben ja k'anab yet jix jaach juli, jix bilwi a jun unin ey xa oc win ti' an. Quichan xa c'al tol chi tzala chi wab an.
Jaachti', xa waoc yin ja c'ul tol oj yun tzet jix yal naj Kaawil e ach. Yuxan, caw tzala c'ulalil ja wei, ẍi Elisabet tu' tet ix María.
Jix lawi tu' xin, jix yalon María jaxca ti':

content.text: —Chi wal watx' k'ane tet naj Kaawil yin masanil jin c'ul.
Caw chi tzala jin c'ul yin Dios cu Colomal.
Jainti', yak'omal jin servil Dios an. C'am nioj wel oc apnoj, pero jix ok' sc'ul Dios win an. Yuxan oj yal eb ánima tobal k'inal tol Dios jix x'ox swatx' c'ulal e in an.
Yutol ja' Dios, caw miman yipal. Miman swatx'ilal jix x'ox e in an. C'am junoj xa bie jaxca sbi Dios.
Tobal k'inal chi ok' sc'ul yin mac jijyom tet.
Jix x'ox el oj tol caw miman yipalil. Jix can can eb chi yec'banne sba yalan yu Dios.
Jix i'le can el eb yaaw yin yopiso, jal eb c'am yel oc apnoj, jix i'le a can eb.
Jix yak' no sc'ul eb ey snochail. Jal eb be'om, c'am nioj tzet jix ak'le tet eb catu' jix ujteletoj eb.
Jix oc ketoj jaon Israel jon ti', jaon yak'omal jon servil ti'. Ma toj q'uey c'ulal yok' sc'ul kin.
Jaxca yalon can tet eb kichmam, yutol yak'naj can sti' tet naj Abraham, c'al tet jantaj eb yic'aal yin junelne, ẍi ix María tu'.

content: Oxeb mi xaaw jix bet ec' María tu' bey Elisabet, catu' jix meltzotej bey sna tu' junel xa.
Yalubal Naj Juan Bautista
Ja' yet jix jul xa c'al stiempoal ali yune' ix Elisabet, winaj unin jun jix ali.
Ja' yet jix yaben eb ánima scawilal c'al eb yican tol jix x'ox swatx' c'ulal naj Kaawil tet ix, jix tzala a eb yetoj ix.

Jujubixi tax ali, catu' jix apni eb bey sna naj Zacarías, yu yale oc jun yechel chi yij sbi circuncisión yin swinajil jun unin tu'. Jix yoche eb jix yij sbi jun unin yin Zacarías, yet watx' chi oc sq'uexel oj smam tu'.
Pero jix yalon ix txutxe tu' tet eb jaxca ti': —C'amaj, Juan oj yija, ẍi ix tet eb.
—¿Tzet yuxan quey tu' oj ja wak' yija? C'am junoj je yetbi quey tu' yoc sbi, ẍi eb tet ix.
Ja' yet jix sk'anlen eb tet smam naj unin tu' yin yechel tzet bieal chi yoche chi yij naj.
Catu' jix sk'anon nioj tzet yetal bey chi tz'ibe ey tu'. Catu' jix s'iben ey oj: “Juan chi yij sbi jun unin ti',” jix s'iben ey oj. Tuxa c'al jix q'uey a sc'ul masanil eb yet jix yilon jun tu'.
Ja' yet jix tz'iben jun tu' yu naj Zacarías, catu' jix jajcha a sti' yu chi ske' sk'anabi. Jix yalon watx' k'ane naj tet Dios tu'.
Yuxan, caw chi q'uey a sc'ul jantaj eb ánima scawilal. Catu' jix abcha sk'umal jun ti' bey masanil jun wonquiltaj tx'otx' bey tx'otx' yul yet Judea tu'.

Ja' masanil eb jix aben wan tu', catu' jix sna'ontane eb, tzet yei. Jix yalon eb jaxca ti': —¿Tzet oj yun yel oc jun unin ti'? ẍi eb. Quey tu' jix yal eb yin naj yutol chi ske' yilon eb tol ey oc yipal naj Kaawil yin jun unin tu'.
Sbit' Naj Zacarías
Ja' smam jun unin tu', ja' ton naj Zacarías. Caw ey oc Santo Espíritu yin. Yuxan jix ak'le k'anab a yu. Jix yalon jaxca ti':

content.text: Kal wej watx' k'ane tet naj Kaawil, cu Diosal jaon Israel jon ti'. Yutol jix jul ku, jaon sconob jon ti', yu cu scolon el oj.
Oj yatej jun cu Colomal caw miman yipal. Ja' snan xol eb yic'aal naj David, naj yak'omal servil Dios, ja' xol eb oj aloj.
Jaxca tu' jix yute yalon can Dios yet peyxa, yet jix yak'balnen eb ẍejab, ja' ton eb profeta, sic'bil el yu Dios.
Jix yal can Dios tol oj cu scol el yul sk'ab eb cajat oc kin, c'al yul sk'ab jantaj eb chi chichon oc sc'ul kin.
Albil pax can tol oj ok' sc'ul yin eb kichmam. Man oj toj q'uey c'ulal jun strato jix yak' yetoj eb, yutol ja' jun strato tu', asan Dios ey yet.
Quey tu' jix yute yak'on can sti' tet kichmam Abraham yet jix slocon sbi tet.
Jix yal can oj tol oj cu scol el yul sk'ab eb cajat oc kin, yet watx' c'am chi cu xiw wej kak'on servil Dios.
Quey tu' oj kute yet watx', watx' ojab cu beybal, asanne ojab yin Dios chi kaoc cu c'ul tobal k'inal.
Jal jaachti' xin, jaach jin c'aal, oj jaach oc ẍejab oj Dios miman yel oc apnoj. Yutol oj jaach baboj sattaj naj Kaawil, catu' oj c'oli swa'nen sna'bal eb ánima, jaxca chi yun swa'xi junoj be.
Jaach oj ja wak' na'cha el yu eb sconob tzet oj yun scolcha eb, catu' oj el can spenail eb yiban.
Yutol cam c'ulnebil jon yu Dios. Caw chi ok' sc'ul cu Diosal kin wej. Jaxca chi yun yaol c'u, catu' chi cu sejteneni, jaxca tu' oj yun sjul jun chejbiltej yu Dios tu'.
Yu sejtenen spixan eb ey ec' xol k'ej k'inal tu'. Eb lalan sto bey camich. Ja' oj tx'oxon pax e on tzet chi yun cu beybalneni, yet watx' yin watx' c'ulal chi cu ec' yetoj, ẍi naj Zacarías.

content: Ja' jun unin tu', jix ch'ib c'al a oj, jix jul sna'bal, catu' jix betle ec' bey cusiltaj tx'otx', masanta' c'al jix a apnoj stiempoal x'oxon a sba tet eb yet Israelal.
